Thank you for your feedback
notes.notes: Hello. Thank you for your feedback. We would like to inform you that at the moment is preparing a patch that will eliminate minor problems discovered after the release, and will also add training, allowing beginners easier to understand what and how to play. Also, the game will soon be added to achieve.
